tickets.title: CT-21: Import Codex worktree inputs and cited evidence; fail closed on missing inputs
tickets.body:
## Parent

The takeover spec issue (#999999).

## What to build

**What to build:** the integration tip stops depending on unsaved Codex worktree data. Copy, hash-verified against the T1 snapshot `MANIFEST.json`, the 58 untracked-class files the tip cites (the A06 release schema and retrieval runs, the nine saved-search runs with comparisons, the A02 one-page captures, the A09 triage and adjudication, the A08 graph audit and edge receipt, the three W5/A-series `docs/agents` audits, the A07b spec-11 candidate pair) and the 61 manifest-hashed `*.log` files to their tip paths (`git add -f` for the logs: only the host's global excludes file ignores them, never the frozen `.gitignore`); declare the 18 iwyu build-tree files and every keep-private set (`evidence/claude-amendment-review/`, the `issue-publication-private` intents, the redacted gitleaks report, the `c658` schema) in a new `dev/cited-inputs.json` with their SHA-256 and the private mirror that holds them. `dev/codex_examples.py` refuses a missing tracked input with exit 3 and a message naming the path instead of a generic `unresolved`; `dev/checkout_transfer.py` takes the old worktree from `--old` or `MARKETPLACE_OLD_WORKTREE` and refuses when neither is given, with no host path in the source. A new `dev/check_inputs.py` (task `check:inputs`) walks every path cited by a tracked retro, an evidence manifest row with `path`+`sha256`, or a declared code default and exits 1 naming each path that is neither in the tree with the recorded hash nor declared in a mirror; the parent wires it into `check`, `check:research` and the development workflow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `./dev/mise run check:inputs` exits 0 on the composed tree and, in a scratch copy with one imported file removed, exits 1 with one line per missing path naming the citing file and line; every imported file's SHA-256 equals its `MANIFEST.json` row (119 files, 1,057,200 bytes), recorded in a receipt under `evidence/codex-imports/`.
- [ ] `./dev/mise run test:examples` gains a test that reads the real `evidence/codex-examples/release/config-schema.json` and the cited `evidence/saved-searches/runs/*` without patching and fails when they are absent or drift from `dev/cited-inputs.json`; the hermetic fixture tests stay; `dev/codex_examples.py` against an absent run or schema exits 3 and names the path; `dev/checkout_transfer.py plan` without `--old` and `MARKETPLACE_OLD_WORKTREE` exits 2 naming both.
- [ ] gitleaks 8.30.1 (built-in rules, `--redact=100`) over the imported files reports 0 findings and the A09 publish records `history_scan_rc`; no keep-private file enters the tree; `check`, `check:acceptance-baseline` (19/19, `.gitignore` untouched) and `git diff --check` stay rc 0.

## Blocked by

- None (can start immediately).

Local ID: CT-21. Execution boundary: one lane, one worktree, explicit path allowlist, about five maintained files and 300 handwritten lines; retro record required before integration; no push, publication, closure or host-heavy operation is implied by this ticket.
